units: delta E in meV/atom; MSE in (meV/atom)^2; Hamming in mobile-site occupations

definitions.fit_macro: Equal-weight composition mean; fit-level RMS is sqrt(equal-weight composition mean of squared differences)
definitions.seed_summary: Descriptive mean/SD across independent fit/sampler replicates, never proposal rows

interpretation.latent_resample: Both latent draws have the same prior and share AR uniforms. Expected signed delta E is zero by identical marginals. Nonzero absolute/RMS response measures sensitivity, not conditional utility or energy accuracy.
interpretation.conditions: LOW to MIDDLE/HIGH shares actual latent and AR uniforms. Positive signed delta E is the direction of the requested energy change.
interpretation.mutation: Condition changes select different TRAIN-bin seed pools; common seed-choice quantiles/edit streams do not make those seed identities equal.
